name: yamachat-mobile
description: Společný Capacitor projekt Yamachat pro Android a iOS.

scripts.native:init: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs all && npx cap sync
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync && node scripts/patch-native.mjs all
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:debug: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:check: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
